comparison_contract.shared_evaluation: Independent evaluator layer runs the same approved cases for both after predictions are sealed; report configuration, assessed candidate and actual post-adaptation coverage separately.

Actual post-adaptation coverage only after materialize and independent re-execution.
secondary_metrics: Ψ operation and governance correctness against separate reference.
Separate current, assessed-candidate and actual post-adaptation coverage.
Adaptation, candidate validation, incremental evaluator and total CI time; resources where available; unknown/HOLD frequency.
comparison_contract.missing_data: UNKNOWN, NOT_EVALUABLE and NOT_MEASURED remain separate; never map to zero, inactive or pass.
